title: Meta quietly launched an ‘AI pet journal’ app
slides: Why is Meta betting on your pet's diary?
It quietly launched an AI pet journal app
The app writes entries from your photos automatically
Pet owners can now track moods without typing
Try it: upload one pet photo and read the entry
thread_text:
1. Your Pet's Secret Diary

Meta quietly launched an AI app that writes journal entries from your pet's photos automatically. No typing required.

2. The Convenience Trap

The app tracks moods and daily activities without any input from you. Is this genuine pet care or just another data grab?

3. Privacy Paws

Meta's history with personal data raises red flags. Your pet's daily life could become training material for future AI models.

4. Emotional Bonding or Automation?

Owners risk outsourcing their emotional connection to an algorithm. Real memories get replaced by auto-generated text.

5. Test It Yourself

Upload one pet photo to the app and read the entry. Does it capture your pet's true personality, or just generic fluff? Try it and judge.

instagram.caption:
Your pet's daily mood log can now write itself from a single photo 📸

Meta quietly released an AI app that turns pet pictures into automatic journal entries — no typing needed.

It also tracks moods and activities with zero input from you.

The catch: Meta's data history means those entries could feed future AI training.

If you post pet content, your audience may soon expect auto-generated stories instead of real moments.

Would you trust an algorithm to describe your dog's day — or does that cross a line? 🐾
